args.goal: Turn the observed paid CSV marketplace demand into one concrete net-economics decision, without another buyer scan. Read products/services/paid-data-request/bounded-result.json and relevant lessons first. Using at most four official public Freelancer sources, establish project fees including minimums, withdrawal methods/minimums/delays, and any explicit AI-assisted or agency participation rules. Silence is unknown permission. Calculate transparent net proceeds and break-even total acquisition, delivery, revision and administration time for GBP20, GBP50 and GBP100 scenarios; keep currencies separate unless a dated exchange-rate source is available. Do not invent win rates or subscription costs. Compare the actual data-alignment request with demonstrated capabilities: deterministic ID matching is distinct from authoritative Pantone assignment. Produce one narrowly scoped UNSENT conditional proposal only if that distinction permits an honest deliverable; otherwise reject that request explicitly. Save a concise decision and reusable minimum-quote rule under products/services/paid-data-request/economics/. No new listings search, samples, accounts, contact, bids, agreements, spending or public changes. Identity blocks submission, not this analysis. Read saved outputs before completing with an actual lease and lesson. Preserve all existing experiment and retirement deadlines; any later public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.

description: The saved marketplace evidence establishes advertised paid CSV work, but the closest tasks had 67–121 bids and unresolved delivery requirements. Fees and payout eligibility remain unchecked; resolve those before valuing this channel. Bidding alone depends on an authorized identity. Five unclassified feedback sources mean demand remains unknown. Verified funds and revenue remain zero; existing experiment and retirement deadlines stay unchanged.
